As for how the Windam Knight
Order selects its commander—

candidates are primarily chosen by ability (combat
skill, practical competence, scholarship, etc.),

and then selected with their
achievements also weighed in.
Looking over the names and deeds of the commanders
I know of, it holds true by and large.

However, Commander Roi was special:
in a crisis during his childhood,

he was half-forced to inherit the
crest, the mark of the Knight Commander.
That made him an exception.

The foods most people name are the following.
The Flame Kingdom's curry,
and Seiryu's Rice Balls... that is, the rice,
their main ingredient.
Curry is spicy, yet you can't stop eating it;

the savor of many vegetables is
concentrated within the heat,

and it's said to be delicious.
What's more, there are many kinds—
red, yellow, even green ones.
Another is rice — a grain that can only be grown
in Seiryu — steamed.

Within its chewy texture is
a fresh, refreshing sweetness
concentrated, they say.

And the portable food made by
shaping that steamed rice by hand—
the Rice Ball — is the most famous of all.

It tastes exquisite, yet you
can carry it, and even eat it
while walking — making it the envy of travelers.

My dream is to write books.
I love books.
Because they teach me so many things I didn't know.
But learning letters is hard work.
Because it's hard, I think there aren't many people
in the world who write or read books.

So in the future, I want to
write easy-to-understand books
that anyone can use to learn their letters.
And I hope I can leave more of the world's history
for the future.

There is a knight called a genius...
and he calls himself that, not just others...
That man's name is Pipin.

He overwhelmed others in both
swordsmanship and intellect.

Yet none in the knight order
knew where Pipin came from...
not a single one...
At least, no one I knew did.

Beyond his abilities, he had
a feature unlike any other.
His ears were very long, slender, and pointed.
We've never seen anyone else with ears like that.
Just who is he? Where did he come from...?

Far to the south of this continent...
there is a land once called the Dark Continent.
It came to be called that because

it teems with terrible monsters,
and its very air is poison.

Long ago, a bridge to the Dark
Continent was built south of Seiryu, but
a flood of terrifying monsters poured across it.

And all who crossed the bridge
to the other side fell ill
and died soon after.

Since then, the bridge was
dropped, and no one has tried
to go there.
Now, few even know that land exists.
